name: City of Canal Winchester
office: Development Department (Planning & Zoning), 45 E. Waterloo Street, Canal Winchester, OH 43110
source: Applications Rev. 01/2025 and Zoning Code 1175 (overlays), supplied by Carter 2026-10-28

applies_when.note: Inside the city limits only. Fairfield County parcels: tax district 042, 055 or 066 ("... CANAL WINCHESTER CORP"). Franklin County parcels: check the auditor's taxing district. A Canal Winchester mailing address does NOT mean the city — Violet / Bloom / Madison Township parcels use the township.

old_town.boundary: Map in the Canal Winchester Old Town Guidelines (on file with Planning & Zoning) — not in the toolkit. Set property.old_town to historic | preservation | none after checking the map or calling 614-837-7501.
old_town.certificate: Certificate of Appropriateness (CoA) before ANY construction, reconstruction, exterior alteration or demolition; no zoning certificate or permit is issued without it
old_town.lead_note: file with the P&Z Administrator at least 15 days before the Landmarks Commission meeting; applicant must attend; deemed approved if no action in 60 days (unless tabled)
old_town.expires: work must start within 1 year; certificate expires if not 50% complete in 1.5 years

materials.historic: traditional materials only — wood, brick or stone — for rehab and new construction (no vinyl siding / vinyl trim)
materials.preservation: new construction: wood, brick or stone; rehab: traditional encouraged, man-made only at the Commission's discretion if in character

criteria: new construction in a style prominent in Old Town (see Old Town Guidelines)
rehab preserves the building's character and style; no false sense of history
height compatible with adjacent buildings and not above the underlying district maximum
additions: width, height, setbacks and style considered against neighbours
application_contents: architect / contractor name and contact, if employed
complete description of the proposed exterior change
plot plan: setbacks, facilities, landscaping, screening, fences, walkways, signs and relation to surrounding structures
plan of changes in site elevations (grading)
names and addresses of adjoining property owners

violet_pointe.boundary: city parcels inside the Canal Winchester / Violet Township CEDA area (Busey Rd north, US 33 south, Franklin County line west, school district east)
violet_pointe.reviewer: CEDA Joint Land Use Committee recommendation for additions and accessory structures

residential.max_height: 2.5 stories or 35 ft, whichever is less (grade at foundation to the highest roof)
residential.four_sided_architecture: front elevation 3 design elements, side/rear 2 (door >= 17 sf, window >= 6 sf, chimney, gable vent >= 4 sf, porch/deck); additions match the house
residential.cladding: brick, stone, wood, stucco, vinyl beaded siding, fiber cement or equal
residential.front_garage: front-loaded garage at least 2 ft behind the front facade

applications.name: Certificate of Appropriateness (Old Town)
applications.form_note: No CoA form was supplied — the planner writes a cover sheet from 1175.01(f)(3). Ask P&Z for their form.
applications.when: old_town in (historic, preservation) and (exterior change or demolition or addition)

applications.name: Variance
applications.when: the design breaks a zoning standard (setback, height, lot coverage) — from the lot check
attach: nature of the variance + code sections
plot plan: lot, existing + proposed structures, the special condition, uses, neighbours' structures

applications.name: Demolition / Moving Permit
applications.when: a whole structure or building is demolished or moved (garage, shed, the house). Partial demolition inside a remodel: confirm with P&Z
attach: survey showing remaining structures and those to be demolished
certificate of insurance: at least $300,000 liability

applications.name: Site Development Plan (major / minor)
applications.when: not normally for one single-family house; required when P&Z calls the project a site plan (multi-family, commercial, a new lot)
attach: site plan by an Ohio PE, >= 1"=100', sheets <= 42x28
1141.05 contents: setbacks, drives, streets, easements, drainage, erosion control, parking, building floors/area/height, elevations, utilities, flood zone

applications.name: Conditional Use
applications.when: the proposed use is conditional in the district (e.g. a duplex / ADU / home business where allowed only conditionally)
attach: owners within / contiguous / across the street

applications.name: Zoning Code and Map Amendment
applications.when: the use is not allowed in the district at all (P&Z hearing + Council) — rare for a rehab

applications.name: Certificate of Zoning Compliance + residential building permit
applications.form_note: Not in the supplied set — ask P&Z (614-837-7501) for the residential zoning / building permit form and who reviews 1- and 2-family plans.
applications.when: always for additions, structural changes, new openings, roof changes
